systems.platform: TECH5 T5-OmniMatch, T5-AirSnap Face, T5-LDS, T5-IDencode / T5-Cryptograph; back end and identity provider by SmartMS; OpenID Connect; source code contributed to MOSIP
systems.owner: Ministry of Digital Transition, Innovation and Public Sector Modernisation (MTNIMA); funded by UNDP
systems.tiers: mobile app for digital onboarding from a passport or contactless ID card and face verification for passwordless login to the e-government portal; pilot tender June 2022, presented 22 March 2023 to more than 70 testers, ran to 1 October 2023

note: The vendor's account of a digital identity pilot for e-government login; nothing on registering births or deaths.
